# CP24

> > CP24 is Toronto's breaking news and weather source, delivering 24-hour coverage of local, national, and international news with a focus on the Greater Toronto Area.

CP24 provides comprehensive news coverage spanning local Toronto events, Canadian national stories, and major international developments including Middle East conflicts and U.S. military operations. The station offers real-time breaking news, traffic updates, weather forecasts, and in-depth reporting on politics, crime, and community issues affecting the GTA and beyond.

## Key Topics

- U.S. Marines
- Middle East
- Iran-Israel conflict
- U.S. military deployment
- International conflict
- Iraq
- Military aircraft operations
- Toronto breaking news
- Canadian news
- GTA coverage
- Weather updates
- Traffic reports
- Political developments
- Community safety

- [Toronto, Canada and Global Breaking News](https://www.cp24.com/news/ontario-reports-784-new...): Breaking news on U.S. Marines, Iran-Israel conflict, and Middle East tensions
